from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Extract credit impairment loss information from a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="The credit impairment loss amount reported; can be negative or positive")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit for the reported amount")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Which financial statement this comes from (e.g., '合并利润表')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt with the value for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
